theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cycle_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity → (∀ (Yj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Yj j).boundary) → (⨆ j, (Yj j).boundary.mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn (fun j => (Yj j).boundary) Y.boundary → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y.boundary) → (∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ j, (Tj j).boundary = 0) → (∀ j, (Tj j).support ⊆ K) → (⨆ j, (Tj j).mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegralCurrent (Tj j)) → (∀ j, (Tj j).support ⊆ K) → (⨆ j, ((Tj j).mass + (Tj j).boundary.mass)) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
